experiment: DTA-assisted G2CP response prediction under global chemical-parent holdout
target_weighting: normalized reciprocal rank; descending predicted KIBA score; protein ID tie break
alpha_selection: one global weight per auxiliary method and training seed, on primary Davis-disjoint validation drugs; average cells within chemical identity before averaging drugs; ties choose smaller alpha
primary_metric: Pearson across all 978 released processed signature values; average cells within identity then identities
test_usage: No test expression for weights, early stopping, graph construction, target or cell selection
published_checkpoint_usage: None; local G2CP initialized randomly, genetic pretraining followed by chemical finetuning
encoder_boundary: Released UniPert representations reused for every comparator; historical representation-training exposure is not independently excluded
expression_processing: Use released processed signatures directly; do not subtract an unmatched consensus control. G2CP retains its control input and output skip connection.
scope: Exploratory kinase-inhibitor subset; not an exact replication of the article-wide G2CP benchmark
annotation_review: Source-annotation consistency review, not independent experimental confirmation of each compound mechanism
